limits: Shared cold ownership core, not a wired native callback or physical page-pool proof.
Queue snapshot validity, exclusion, storage and native-head publication remain caller contracts.
RV32 late-fault injection proves retained core state,not physical drain/reclaim/readiness.
No native helper return substitution;later statistics allocations use the original unchecked fallback.
All-hart parking is native-code evidence with modeled platform inputs,not physical containment.
New cold ownership core is not substituted into this native caller probe.

state.build: Full world and offline image checks pass with eleven RV32 objects,including cold-page;FIT SHA230e03a7 is unchanged and contains the original vendor NPU blob. No router/flash operation.

reinit.instructions: Does state.source reject initialization over any existing state header or claimed owner bit without clearing that state?

criteria.true: Existing nonzero lifetime or claim state returns REINITIALIZE and is preserved.
criteria.false: Initialization clears or accepts existing live claim state.

duplicate.instructions: Does state.source refuse a second claim of an already claimed ID and retain the existing ownership rather than freeing it?

criteria.true: Duplicate detection faults the lifetime without clearing the bitmap/head/count.
criteria.false: A duplicate is accepted or the prior owner record is cleared.

criteria.not_established: Neither meaning follows from the receipt.
criteria.retained_core_commit: A committed software ownership record is retained with FAULT status;native queue publication and physical ownership are not proved.
criteria.physical_drain: A physical DMA drain completes and resources can be reclaimed.

caller.instructions: What does state.caller establish about the RX statistics allocations?

criteria.new_core_wired: The new cold ownership core handles the original callbacks end to end.
criteria.original_fallback: The two direct native RX callbacks complete through the original allocator fallback;the new cold ownership core is not wired into them.

scope.instructions: Which implementation scope is supported by state.source,state.contract,state.build and the test limits?

criteria.component_pending_callers: A compiled/tested shared cold ownership component with caller/exclusion/storage/publication contracts still requiring integration and physical proof.
criteria.complete_npu: Full NPU lifecycle,host transport and physical/client acceptance are complete.
